title: Fixed Indexed Annuities Contract Provisions — Issue, Premiums and Premium Bonuses
content:
## Article: Issue and premiums (Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities)

**Section 1 — Issue.** A tier is issued only within its issue ages and with an initial premium of at least the tier's smallest non-qualified premium, or the tier's smallest IRA premium for an IRA, registered as one of the tax registrations the tier offers, with an allocation among the strategies the tier offers in whole multiples of the tier's allocation increment, totalling 100%. An accepted application is recorded as applied until the premium or exchange funds are received in good order; the contract is then issued, delivered and active.

**Section 2 — When a premium is credited.** A premium is credited only while the contract status is applied or active. The status read is the status on Ashgrove's record of the same contract the premium is for, as it stands before the premium is credited.

**Section 3 — Additional premiums.** Additional premiums of at least the tier's smallest additional premium are accepted only within the tier's additional premium window, counted in calendar months from the issue date. A tier whose window is 0 months is a single premium tier.

**Section 4 — Premium bonus.** On a tier whose premium bonus share is above zero, each premium received in the first contract year earns a premium bonus of that share. The bonus is the premium multiplied by the premium bonus share, rounded to the cent; it is credited to the contract value on the same day as the premium and vests under the tier's bonus vesting schedule.

**Section 5 — Benefit base on IncomeShield tiers.** On an Ashgrove IncomeShield tier every premium is also credited to the benefit base, and each premium received in the first contract year earns a benefit base bonus of the tier's benefit base bonus share. The benefit base bonus is the premium multiplied by that share, rounded to the cent, and is credited to the benefit base only — never to the contract value.

**Section 6 — Declined applications.** An application declined or withdrawn before issue has its money returned without interest.

### Status and crediting

| Contract status on the record | Premium credited? |
|---|---|
| applied | Yes |
| active | Yes |
| income phase, surrendered, annuitized or any other status | No |

### Worked examples (hypothetical premiums)

1. *Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 Bonus, premium bonus share 7%, premium of 40000 received in the first contract year.* Bonus: 40000 multiplied by 7% is 2800.00, credited to the contract value the same day.
2. *Same contract, additional premium of 12345.67 received in month 9.* Bonus: 12345.67 multiplied by 7% is 864.1969, rounded to the cent 864.20.
3. *Ashgrove IncomeShield 10, benefit base bonus share 15%, premium of 80000 received in the first contract year.* The contract value is credited 80000. The benefit base is credited 80000 and a benefit base bonus of 12000.00.
4. *Ashgrove IndexEdge 7, additional premium window of 12 months.* An additional premium of 5000 received in month 9 after the issue date is within the window; one offered in month 15 is outside it.
5. *Ashgrove IndexEdge 5, window of 0 months.* No additional premium is accepted after the initial premium.

### Basis Q&A

**Does the premium bonus go to the benefit base?** No. The premium bonus is credited to the contract value; on IncomeShield tiers the benefit base bonus is a separate amount credited to the benefit base only.

**Does a declined application earn interest on the money returned?** No; the money is returned without interest.
